purpose: This table is a small, static reference dataset mapping two-letter airline carrier codes to their full legal airline names, intended to feed joins against flight-level fact tables that record only the carrier code.
usage: Consumers should join on the carrier column (the declared grain) to enrich flight records with a human-readable airline_name; both columns are fully populated (null_rate 0.0) so no null-handling logic is required for this table.
limitations: The profile shows only 16 rows with no duplicates and no nulls, so no cleanup beyond dropping Airbyte capture metadata and renaming 'name' to 'airline_name' was needed; consumers should be aware this reference table may need periodic refresh if new carriers enter the source system.
